metaTitle: Guide for your own training diary — P.L.A.W
metaDescription: How to keep your own training diary in P.L.A.W: sign up as a player, log your practices with your own drills and see where your training time goes.
title: Keep your own training diary
subtitle: For players whose coach does not use P.L.A.W — you log your practices yourself.

steps.title: Create your diary
steps.body: Sign up and pick "Player (my own practice diary)". The app is ready for you right away — your own card is already there. The first 14 days are a trial; after that the diary is paid.

steps.title: Set up your drill codes
steps.body: For each focus you get 20 slots for your drills. The account starts with example codes, so you can log a practice right away — rename any slot to the drill you really do. Your analytics break down exactly by these codes.

link.text: See what the example codes mean

steps.title: Plan a practice
steps.body: Create a practice with a date, time and duration. You see it in your calendar right away.

steps.title: Log what you did
steps.body: Add drills to the practice — focus, shot character, code and duration. After the practice, fill in the actual time and notes, and lock it — it becomes a permanent record.

steps.title: See where your time goes
steps.body: Analytics by week, month, quarter and year, compared to last season — broken down by drill code and shot character.

steps.title: Share it, if you want
steps.body: In My profile you can generate a code for your parent or manager — they see your practices, read-only. Do you have a fitness coach who uses P.L.A.W? Link with them and their sessions show up in your calendar.

drillCodesIntro: Every new diary starts with these codes, so you can log a practice right away. They are only examples — keep them, or rename any slot to your own drill; your analytics follow whatever codes you use. You find them in the app under Drill codes.
tips: Add the app to your phone's home screen and use it like a native app right on the court.
The app is in English and always shows time in your own time zone.
ctaText: Create your diary in a few minutes and log your first practice today.
